description: This file defines a UsageTracker class for managing usage events, cooldowns, and statistics within a VSCode extension, including methods for consuming usage, retrieving usage data, and managing cooldowns.

classes.name: UsageTracker
classes.description: A singleton class for tracking and managing usage events, cooldowns, and statistics within a VSCode extension.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance with the given extension context.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Records a usage event for a provider with a specific type and count.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Retrieves usage statistics for a provider within a specified time window.

methods.name: getAllUsage
methods.description: Retrieves usage statistics for a provider over minute, hour, and day durations.

methods.name: getPrunedEvents
methods.description: Filters usage events to only include recent ones within the last day.

methods.name: clearAllUsageData
methods.description: Clears all stored usage and cooldown data.

methods.name: setCooldown
methods.description: Sets a cooldown period for a provider.

methods.name: isUnderCooldown
methods.description: Checks if a provider is currently under cooldown.

methods.name: getPrunedCooldowns
methods.description: Filters cooldowns to only include active ones.
